title: Base change of an etale morphism of schemes is etale (Stacks 02GO)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism] and $g:S'\to S$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the base change $X\times_SS'\to S'$ (second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) is etale. (Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GO.)
